exposure: Elevated amniotic neutrophil elastase levels (>=0.15 mg/ml)
Elevated peripheral C-reactive protein levels (>=0.4 mg/dl)
outcome: Delivery at or after 28 weeks gestation
cohort: The study included women with singleton pregnancies who had bulging fetal membranes and underwent amniocentesis to determine amniotic fluid neutrophil elastase levels before 26+0 weeks gestation.
finding: Rescue cerclage via the McDonald procedure was associated with a higher likelihood of reaching at least 28 weeks gestation, while protruding membranes, elevated amniotic neutrophil elastase, elevated peripheral C-reactive protein, and amniorrhexis were associated with a reduced likelihood.
gest_age: Women with bulging fetal membranes before 26+0 weeks gestation, with outcomes related to delivery at or after 28 weeks gestation.
